paragraphs: Rav Revai of Rov. In Sanhedrin 43a: ‘They give him a grain of frankincense to drink,’ etc. ‘If none is donated, from whose funds?’ Rav Rava of Rov said, ‘It stands to reason: from the public's’ (this is not in the Gemara before us). He was a gaon, lived very long, and was fixed in the Gemara among the later rabbis, the Savoraim. His academy was near Nehardea (Rav Sherira Gaon in Yuhasin). See Part I, year 4300 [source cites 4287].
